If the Service Discovery Module is in Repetition Phase and a TCP- based socket connection has been lost (i.e. Socket connection is other than SOAD_ SOCON_ONLINE), the Service Discovery Module shall call: • SoAd_ReleaseRemoteAddr() • SoAd_DisableSpecificRouting() • SoAd_CloseSoCon() • delete all internally stored subscriptions belonging to that connection. • SoAd_OpenSoCon() The Service Discovery Module shall stay in the Repetition Phase.
